summary: Female hiker on a Continental Divide Trail trek was struck in the lower left leg by a rolling rock while descending a steep, treacherous incline near Platoro, breaking her tibia; the couple pushed their SPOT emergency beacon. Flight for Life from Durango dropped a nurse team that climbed a snow-filled avalanche chute to reach her; the Conejos County sheriff and undersheriff were airlifted to the scene from Platoro. She was carried off the mountain and flown to the Pagosa Springs hospital.
location: Snow-filled avalanche chute near Platoro, Continental Divide Trail
responding_agency: Conejos County Sheriff's Office; Conejos County Search and Rescue; Flight for Life (Durango, Pueblo)
notes: Extracted in the same June 9, 2021 SAR operation as a second, unassociated male hiker who fell several hundred feet down the same chute (separate row). Sheriff's newsletter notes four Conejos County high-country SAR responses in the first half of June 2021, two with Flight for Life.
